standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
register: essay_rooms — the sovereign reading surface (THE-RETURN-OF-ZERO.md + its section/station reading path)

scene_rhythm.note: station scenes hold slightly longer than movement scenes: a station is entered, read, and left

grammar.path: nine scenes: eight station scenes (ids = canonical room slugs) in reading order §0/1 → §0 → §1 → §2 → §3 → §4 → §5 → §5→0, then one closing return scene (08-the-return) carrying the M48 → M01 Return
grammar.form: one governing formation per station; the formation encodes the station's own burden (open disc at the threshold, yantra at the tattvic descent, ring at the zero, inverse pair at the two logics, wound rings at the substrate, two discs at the psychoid, six discs at the products, nested rings at the instrument)
grammar.text_layers: layer 1 editorial: kicker (reading path + station number + movements range), title (canonical station name), italic (station burden, verbatim from the reading root), body (first movement, room release line, previous/next station); layer 2 route: movements range + room slug pointer
grammar.withholdings: no mechanism imagery before station 07; no 0/1 glyphs before station 03 (earned at §1 · #5→0 = M18); the crossed zero Ø is not restaged at station level (its one job lives in room 02 movement-16)

overrides.closing_return_scene: dark ground #161a17, inkMode whiteOnBlack, light palette — the closing return is the root symbolon earned; corpus-base symbolon register policy; the journey loops back to the lit threshold
